hard_truth: Sahm Founders is an SME brand and identity campaign operator — supporting a government authority. Products are identity systems, campaign assets, and internal communication tools for entrepreneurs and SMEs.
signature_serving_system: Practical identity and campaign kits that an SME founder can actually use — not a theoretical brand manual. Every deliverable is deployment-ready.

institutional_identity_system.identity_dna: A complete visual identity system for the authority — logo, colors, typography, iconography — designed to feel modern and capable without the bureaucratic heaviness of a government entity.
institutional_identity_system.signature: An identity that makes a founder say 'I want my business to look like that' — not 'that looks like a ministry'

campaign_creative_system.identity_dna: A campaign creative platform built on a single unifying idea — with a hero headline, a visual system, and an Arabic-first messaging framework that works internally and externally.
campaign_creative_system.signature: A campaign that feels like it was built for entrepreneurs — not about them

internal_communications_kit.identity_dna: A practical communications kit for the authority's teams — email templates, presentation decks, letterheads, and internal signage — all aligned with the new identity.
internal_communications_kit.signature: The kind of kit that makes every team member feel like they work somewhere serious

digital_social_campaign.identity_dna: A social media campaign designed to reach entrepreneurs at the moment they're considering registration or seeking support — practical, energizing, and in their language.
digital_social_campaign.signature: Posts that a founder saves and shares with their co-founder — not generic motivational content

sme_service_explainer_series.identity_dna: A short-form explainer video series covering the authority's core services — designed for entrepreneurs who don't have time to read the brochure.
sme_service_explainer_series.signature: Videos that make the service feel accessible and the authority feel like a partner, not a bureaucracy

founder_success_content_series.identity_dna: A documentary-style content series featuring real (simulated for synthetic) SME founder stories — showing the transformation from idea to funded, recognized business.
founder_success_content_series.signature: Stories that make a struggling founder feel like success is a process, not a lottery
